page.notes: The Greek word ἐντελεχισμὸς and the Hebrew התמיד are reproduced from the scan with doubt on the Greek. The "II." at the start of the second paragraph is a paragraph number, not a heading. Some letters at the line ends are faint, such as "expiandα", which is printed with an α-like form and may be "expiandα" or "expiandα" with a Greek alpha; the word is copied as the scan appears.
